dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、あの、義理の姉が無神経で大嫌いなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, um, my sister-in-law is so insensitive, and I really hate her.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね苦手な方とのおつきあいは辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I see. Dealing with someone you don't get along with can be really tough.

dialogue.content: はい、できるだけ会いたくないんですけど
dialogue.English: Yes, I try to avoid seeing her as much as possible.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫が長男で、何かと言うとうちに集まることが多くて、どうしても会わなきゃならなくて
dialogue.English: My husband is the eldest son, so everyone tends to gather at our house for any occasion, and I have no choice but to see her.

dialogue.content: 話の途中ですみません相談者さまをニックネームでもよいのでなんとお呼びすればよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but what should I call you? A nickname is fine too.

dialogue.content: 佳子です。
dialogue.English: I'm Keiko.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 佳子さまのお宅がご実家で、皆さんお集りになることが多いのですね
dialogue.English: So, Keiko, your home is like the family home where everyone often gathers.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。最低でも月命日の法事があるので、毎月２０日に20人くらい集まるんです。
dialogue.English: That's right. At the very least, there's a memorial service on the anniversary of the death each month, so about 20 people gather on the 20th of every month.

dialogue.content: 20人も！それだけでも大変ですよね
dialogue.English: Twenty people! That alone must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。夫には姉が3人いるんですが、みんな私を小間使いみたいに扱って
dialogue.English: It is. My husband has three older sisters, and they all treat me like a maid.

dialogue.content: もてなすだけでも大変な事を更に、小間使い扱いされたり、無神経な方を受け入れがたいですね
dialogue.English: It's already difficult just to host everyone, but to be treated like a maid and deal with insensitive people on top of that must be unbearable.

dialogue.content: はい、毎日、明日のことを考えるだけで憂鬱になります
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel depressed every day just thinking about what's to come.

dialogue.content: 小間使いは酷いですね・・・毎月の事なのに手伝おうとはなさらない。と・・・
dialogue.English: Being treated like a maid is terrible... And they don't offer to help, even though it's a monthly event...

dialogue.content: はい、当たり前のように何もしません。
dialogue.English: Yes, they do absolutely nothing, as if it's my duty.

dialogue.content: おまけに色々文句言ったり、指図したり
dialogue.English: On top of that, they complain and order me around.

dialogue.content: 当たり前ですか・・・まだ、実家に帰ってきた。感覚で佳子さんの苦労が何もわかってない感じですね
dialogue.English: As if it's your duty... It sounds like they still act as if they've just come back to their family home and don't understand at all the trouble you go through, Keiko.

dialogue.content: 文句までおしゃられるのですね！
dialogue.English: They even complain to you!

dialogue.content: 私が、我慢して言われた通りにやるので、みんな平気なんです
dialogue.English: Because I endure it and do as I'm told, they don't think anything of it.

dialogue.content: 佳子さんは、お気遣いをなされながら我慢なさってしまうのですねそれは毎月、前の日が頭も胃も痛くなりそうです・・・
dialogue.English: So, Keiko, you endure it all while trying to be considerate. I imagine the day before must give you a headache and a stomachache every month...

dialogue.content: はい、もう嫌です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm sick of it.

dialogue.content: その中でも一番許せないのが、無神経な方な訳でしょうか
dialogue.English: And among all of this, is it the insensitive person you find most unforgivable?

dialogue.content: 夫の家はいわゆる名家で、みんな学歴も立派で、私が大学を出てないからって見下してるんです。
dialogue.English: My husband's family is what you'd call a distinguished family. They all have impressive educational backgrounds, and they look down on me because I didn't go to college.

dialogue.content: 名家と言われるお宅に嫁がれたのですね尋常じゃないご苦労がおありでしょね
dialogue.English: So you married into a so-called distinguished family. You must be going through extraordinary hardships.

dialogue.content: はい、もう辛くて
dialogue.English: Yes, it's just so painful.

dialogue.content: その上、学歴の事まで言い出されたら本当にたまったものではないですよねお辛い・・・
dialogue.English: On top of everything else, to have them bring up your educational background... that must be truly unbearable. How painful for you...

dialogue.content: この前も、私が転んで手首を捻挫してたので、月命日の用意が思うようにできずにいたら、しょうがないわねーって散々嫌味言われて、もう泣きたくなりました
dialogue.English: The other day, I had sprained my wrist after a fall, so I couldn't prepare for the monthly memorial service as well as I wanted to. They made all sorts of sarcastic remarks like, "Well, I guess it can't be helped," and it made me want to cry.

dialogue.content: 酷過ぎる！お怪我の労いもなく嫌味や文句ですか・・・そんな状況で２０日の日を一日お耐えになられたのですね
dialogue.English: That's horrible! No concern for your injury, just sarcasm and complaints... And you had to endure the entire day like that.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと用意できないなら、前もって仕出しくらい注文しておけばいいのにって、、、
dialogue.English: They said things like, "If you can't prepare properly, you should have just ordered catering in advance..."

dialogue.content: そういう選択もあったかもしれませんが、お怪我の労いや、出来る事を頑張られた事にはスルーなんんですね
dialogue.English: That might have been an option, but they completely ignored your injury and the fact that you did your best under the circumstances.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは
dialogue.English: And your husband—

dialogue.content: そんな事をご存じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is he aware of all this?

dialogue.content: はい、夫は姉たちが怖いので何も言いません。笑って見過ごしている感じで、あとからまあしょうがないだろ。って言うくらいで
dialogue.English: Yes, but my husband is afraid of his sisters, so he doesn't say anything. He just kind of laughs it off, and later he might say something like, "Well, what can you do?"

dialogue.content: 夫さんも、佳子さんの見方になるどころかお姉さまが怖いのが先にきてしまわれるのですね
dialogue.English: So instead of taking your side, your husband's fear of his sisters comes first.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 笑いで誤魔化すしか無いのでしょうが味方になってほしいところですよね
dialogue.English: I suppose he feels he has no choice but to laugh it off, but you must want him to be on your side.

dialogue.content: はい、もう少し思いやりがあってほしいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I wish he were a little more considerate.

dialogue.content: これが永遠に続くかと思うと本当に辛いです
dialogue.English: It's truly painful to think this will go on forever.

dialogue.content: 怖いのは仕方ないとしても、お二人になられたらきちんと言葉で労ってもらわないとやってられないですね！
dialogue.English: Even if it's understandable that he's scared, it must be unbearable if he doesn't properly acknowledge your efforts with words when you're alone together!

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 毎月、２０日には20人近くの人が集まり、御もてなしをしなければならないが、手伝うわけでもなく
dialogue.English: Every month on the 20th, nearly 20 people gather, and you have to host them, but they don't help.

dialogue.content: 我が家に帰ってきた感じで、小間使いのように扱われ文句や、命令などされ労われくこともなく
dialogue.English: They act like they're just coming home, treat you like a maid, complain, give orders, and show no appreciation for your efforts.

dialogue.content: 20日に一日を毎月毎月、お耐えになってるがもう辛すぎる事に耐えられない。という事でよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: You've been enduring that whole day on the 20th, month after month, but now it's become too painful to bear. Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: ２０日の
dialogue.English: On the 20th...

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。でも逃げ出すわけにもいかないし
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. But I can't just run away.

dialogue.content: そうですよねこんなにお辛いのに逃げることもなく耐えてこられたのですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. You've endured this without running away, even though it's been so painful.

dialogue.content: 夫は気弱ですが、離婚したいとは思えません
dialogue.English: My husband is timid, but I don't want to divorce him.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、お姉さんには弱く怖くて意見も言えないが、佳子さんにとっては愛すべき存在なのですね
dialogue.English: So, while your husband may be too weak and scared to speak up to his sisters, he is still someone you love.

dialogue.content: はい。そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 今までで一番お辛かったエピソードを教えて頂いても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if you told me about the most painful episode you've experienced so far?

dialogue.content: 義姉の長男の結婚式の時、私が化粧室に行っている間に、親族の集合写真を撮ってしまっていたことです。
dialogue.English: At my sister-in-law's eldest son's wedding, they took the family group photo while I was in the restroom, without me.

dialogue.content: あとから仕方ないって感じで、撮り直したんですけど
dialogue.English: They took another one afterward with a "well, I guess it can't be helped" attitude, but...

dialogue.content: なんか、私のせいみたいな雰囲気になって
dialogue.English: The atmosphere made it seem like it was my fault.

dialogue.content: いたたまれませんでした
dialogue.English: I felt so out of place.

dialogue.content: 記念撮影の大事な思い出に入れて貰えなかったのですか！！取り直しても存在自体無視な感じですよねそれは居たたまれなさすぎる・・・
dialogue.English: You were left out of such an important commemorative photo! Even if they retook it, it's like they were ignoring your very existence. That must have been unbearably awkward...

dialogue.content: 思い出しても涙が出ます
dialogue.English: Even remembering it brings tears to my eyes.

dialogue.content: 私は一体なんなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What am I to them?

dialogue.content: ええ辛過ぎるの一言ではもう現しきれませんね
dialogue.English: Yes, 'painful' doesn't even begin to describe it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さん達に、何か反抗してみた事や、反論したことはおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried to resist or talk back to your sisters-in-law?

dialogue.content: 気持ち的には言ってやりたいんですが、とてもできません
dialogue.English: I feel like I want to say something, but I just can't.

dialogue.content: それほどの威圧感の中にいらっしゃるのですねよく頑張ってこられましたね
dialogue.English: You're in such an intimidating environment. You've done so well to endure it.

dialogue.content: ただ
dialogue.English: However...

dialogue.content: これからは、少しでも20日の日が楽になれるようにしていきたいですよね
dialogue.English: From now on, we want to find a way to make the 20th of each month a little easier for you, don't we?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんな、非人道的な扱いに耐えてこられた事は報われるべきです
dialogue.English: You deserve to be rewarded for enduring such inhumane treatment.

dialogue.content: はい、そう思いたいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to think so.

dialogue.content: 反抗や反論がとても出来る状態でなければお願いなどした事はおありですか？
dialogue.English: If resisting or talking back isn't possible, have you ever tried asking them for something?

dialogue.content: ほぼありません。
dialogue.English: Almost never.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、表建てカバーはしてくれなくても気持ちは理解してくれる感じですよね他に望まれることはおありですか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like your husband understands how you feel, even if he doesn't defend you publicly. Is there anything else you wish for?

dialogue.content: 夫にですか？
dialogue.English: From my husband?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 例えば
dialogue.English: For example,

dialogue.content: 皆さんが帰った後にもっと気持ちの部分を受け止めて欲しいとか
dialogue.English: do you wish he would acknowledge your feelings more after everyone has left?

dialogue.content: そうですね。時々私の好きなアイスクリーム買ってきてくれたりもするんですが、気持ちをもっと受け止めてくれたら嬉しいですね
dialogue.English: That's true. He sometimes buys me my favorite ice cream, but I would be happy if he acknowledged my feelings more.

dialogue.content: 好きな物を把握して買ってきてくれるお優しさがおありなのですね。素敵ですねそうですよね、我慢してきた今日の出来事を受け止めてくれたら報われますよね
dialogue.English: So he is kind enough to know what you like and buy it for you. That's lovely. Yes, it would feel rewarding if he acknowledged what you endured that day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんに、聞いて欲しい。とおしゃった事はおありですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever told your husband that you want him to listen?

dialogue.content: 夫には愚痴を聞いてもらうこともありますよ
dialogue.English: I do vent to my husband sometimes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねでは、お二人は心ではしっかり繋がっているのでしょかね
dialogue.English: I see. So perhaps the two of you are strongly connected emotionally.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: それはよかったです！
dialogue.English: That's wonderful to hear!

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: もっと言葉として受け止めてくれた感が欲しい所でもありますよね
dialogue.English: ...you still wish he would verbally acknowledge and validate your feelings more.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: 今まで、耐えがたい事を我慢なさって、逃げたくなる気持ちも抑えて踏ん張ってこられた全てをお話ししたら夫さんは何と言ってくれそうですか？
dialogue.English: If you told your husband everything—how you've endured unbearable things and held on even when you wanted to run away—what do you think he would say?

dialogue.content: それは、自分と一緒になったんだから、我慢してもらわなきゃならないというと思います。
dialogue.English: He would probably say, "You married me, so you have to put up with it."

dialogue.content: (時間ずいぶんすぎてしまいました。途中ですが終了した方がよいですよね？)
dialogue.English: (We've gone quite over time. Should we end here, even though we're in the middle?)

dialogue.content: （最後、締めておわりのかたちにもっていってください）
dialogue.English: (Please wrap it up and bring it to a close.)

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But,

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫も義姉たちに対してのことは、私にとても感謝していると思います
dialogue.English: I think my husband is very grateful to me for how I handle his sisters.

dialogue.content: 我慢してもらわなきゃ。と言われたとしても夫さんが感じてる感謝の気持ちはしっかり佳子さんに伝わってらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: So even if he says you have to "put up with it," you can still clearly feel the gratitude he has for you.

dialogue.content: はい、夫はわかってくれていると思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think my husband understands.

dialogue.content: それは大きな救いですね夫さんの逃げ腰になられる手ごわい相手に二人の心が一緒に向かってる感じですね
dialogue.English: That's a great comfort, isn't it? It sounds like both of your hearts are united against these formidable opponents that make your husband want to back down.

dialogue.content: そんな感じもしてきました！
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel that way!

dialogue.content: そうですか！はた目には気の弱い、言いなりになっている様に見えるお二人がスクラム組んで立ち向かう姿勢は敵なしな感じがしますね
dialogue.English: Is that so! To outsiders, you might both seem meek and submissive, but the thought of you two teaming up to face this together feels unbeatable.

dialogue.content: うん。そこまでは強靭ではないんですが、なんとか頑張ろうと思います
dialogue.English: Yeah... we're not that strong, but I'll try to keep doing my best.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか頑張れそうで良かったですこれからも夫さんには遠慮なく愚痴はその日の内に消化できると良いですね
dialogue.English: I see. I'm glad to hear you feel you can keep trying. I hope you'll continue to feel comfortable venting to your husband and getting it off your chest each day.

dialogue.content: はい、そうできるよう努めます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try to do that.

dialogue.content: はい、お二人の心のスクラムで乗り切って頂けるよ願っております
dialogue.English: Yes, I hope that with your hearts united, you will be able to get through this.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話ししてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: また、何かありましたらお越しください
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back if anything comes up.

dialogue.content: はい、励ましていただきありがとうございました。もう少し頑張ってみます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for the encouragement. I'll try to hang in there a little longer.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、私も応援しておりますので頑張り過ぎず乗り越えてくださいね以上で今日は終了になりますが大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll be rooting for you, so please try not to push yourself too hard as you navigate this. This concludes our session for today. Is that all right?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: では、今日は本当にありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Well then, thank you so much for today.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした！お相手ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Good work! Thank you for the session.)

dialogue.content: (時間オーバーでおつきあいくださりありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for staying with me even though we went over time.)

dialogue.content: （いえいえこちらこそ）
dialogue.English: (Not at all, thank you.)

dialogue.content: (また、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします。では、終了させていただきますね。ありがとございました。)
dialogue.English: (I hope we can meet again. Well then, I'll end the session now. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （はい、了解です。またよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Yes, understood. I look forward to next time.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます。失礼いたします。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Goodbye.)
